scope: Source verification only. Runtime success and latency must be joined from actual experiment records.

candidates.name: Audiobox Aesthetics PQ
candidates.input: audio path or tensor+sample_rate; internal 16k mono, 10s chunks
candidates.output: PQ/PC/CE/CU, trained scale 1-10; larger is better per axis but PC is complexity
candidates.risk: mono and 16k miss stereo and >8k artifacts; production quality is broader than unnatural synthetic timbre

candidates.name: PAM
candidates.output: softmax clean-vs-noisy/artifacts CLAP similarity, 0-1 high clean; uncalibrated
candidates.local_feasibility: CPU/CUDA; older dependency pins need adaptation
candidates.risk: prompt/content bias; upstream stereo reshape; cannot interpret output as human defect probability

candidates.name: Frozen encoder + domain artifact preference head
candidates.domain: user-defined unwanted synthetic artifacts in generated music
candidates.reference: no reference at inference; same-prompt pairs for training
candidates.input: frozen audio embedding; optional prompt and diagnostics
candidates.output: Bradley-Terry scalar; calibrated naturalness only after held-out human labels
candidates.code_license: new local head; encoder terms separate
candidates.weight_license: encoder dependent; MuQ and MERT are non-commercial
candidates.local_feasibility: small head trainable locally after labels; encoder scoring dominates
candidates.risk: not trained/validated yet; style and generator leakage require grouped splits

candidates.name: MuQ-Eval A1
candidates.weight_license: head declared MIT; MuQ backbone CC-BY-NC-4.0
candidates.local_feasibility: PyTorch; ~310M backbone; authors GPU timing is not local measurement
candidates.risk: single-dataset CV not new-model generalization; audio-only TA cannot check actual text

candidates.name: MuQ / MuQ-MuLan
candidates.role: feature backbone research only when license fits
candidates.risk: semantic embeddings can ignore subtle artifacts and encode instrument/style

candidates.name: SongEval
candidates.input: librosa mono 24k audio; frozen MuQ hidden_states[6]; five-head Generator
candidates.output: Exact API keys/order: Coherence, Musicality, Memorability, Clarity, Naturalness; tanh*2+3 yields (1,5)
candidates.local_feasibility: CPU supported with speed warning; GPU preferred
candidates.risk: Paper/README Naturalness means vocal breathing and phrasing; Clarity means song structure; neither is a validated full-mix artifact score. Short crops miss structure.

candidates.name: MuseCritic
candidates.input: audio + aesthetic rubric; critique then score
candidates.code_license: root repo had no visible LICENSE; check components before redistribution
candidates.local_feasibility: large ALM stack, official CUDA-oriented example; not assumed practical on current machine
candidates.risk: vocal naturalness narrower than unwanted electronic artifacts; critique cost and potential hallucination

candidates.name: CMI-RM
candidates.reference: optional conditioning audio; no clean reference required
candidates.code_license: Apache-2.0 toolkit LICENSE; README badge inconsistent
candidates.local_feasibility: 0.7B F32 model; actual runtime should reuse existing arm records
candidates.risk: toolkit license does not cover weights; overall quality not defect specificity

candidates.name: SongBench
candidates.code_license: SongBench academic-only, commercial and production prohibited
candidates.local_feasibility: public inference implementation; reuse existing arm
candidates.risk: instrument realism can encode acoustic/electronic style; unavailable for production under published terms

candidates.name: TuneJury
candidates.code_license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 root project; check file variants
candidates.weight_license: primary CC-BY-NC-4.0; A1_clap_audio_only Apache-2.0; encoders separate
candidates.local_feasibility: ~2.8M head + large frozen encoders; CLAP ~2.2GB; MERT gated
candidates.role: future preference baseline / head design reference
candidates.risk: instrumental scope and content/style preferences; aggressive optimization may trade fidelity

candidates.name: SingMOS / SingMOS-Pro
candidates.weight_license: public torch.hub checkpoints; verify backbone and checkpoint terms separately
candidates.role: only when a genuine vocal stem is available
candidates.risk: mixture out-of-domain; separator artifacts confound separated vocal scores

candidates.name: UTMOS
candidates.weight_license: checkpoint and fairseq upstream terms should be retained
candidates.risk: music may be penalized as non-speech

candidates.name: DNSMOS P.835
candidates.risk: desired music treated as interference/background; not music naturalness

candidates.name: NISQA / NISQA-TTS
candidates.risk: domain mismatch and separate naturalness checkpoint; code license is not weights license

candidates.name: FAD / FADtk
candidates.reference: reference distribution required, not aligned reference waveform
candidates.input: reference and evaluation audio sets; selected encoder
candidates.output: distribution distance; optional per-song outlier score; lower is closer
candidates.risk: genre/content/reference selection dominate; no direct per-clip unnaturalness interpretation

candidates.name: ViSQOL Audio
candidates.weight_license: bundled official models under repository terms
candidates.risk: another song cannot be a fidelity reference for a novel generation

candidates.name: SONICS SpecTTTra
candidates.domain: AI-generated vs human song provenance detection
candidates.output: synthetic provenance classification score, not artifact severity
candidates.weight_license: inspect selected checkpoint card; dataset CC-BY-NC-4.0 with extra no-competing-product terms
candidates.local_feasibility: public inference; reproduction requirements are 48GB GPU/32GB RAM, not inference minimum
candidates.role: forensic research only, reject as naturalness reward
candidates.risk: synthetic origin is not perceived unnaturalness; imperceptible fingerprints and acquisition/domain shift can dominate

candidates.name: MusicDET
candidates.domain: AI-generated detection via real-music feature density
candidates.reference: no paired reference; trained real-music distribution
candidates.local_feasibility: public local PyTorch code; not run in this research task
candidates.role: forensic auxiliary only, reject as primary naturalness reward
candidates.risk: real-music density also detects rare genres/timbres and corpus shift; no proof that lower AI score means better music
